entries.title: Blocked and Time limits
entries.line: What is always off and how long things may be used now live in two clear places. A site you block reaches your child's browser within seconds.
steps: Open Settings and choose a child.
Under Filtering and blocking, Blocked and allowed sites lists the sites and parts of sites that are always off.
Time limits sets how long they can use sites and apps each day.
entries.tip: A site blocked on one child's list blocks only that child.

entries.title: Explore starts with search
entries.line: A search box sits above Discover and Topics, so finding vetted content doesn't start with browsing.

entries.title: Library has a page of its own
entries.line: A card for each section, drawn as what it holds, then what's new, what you visited recently, and what you starred and hearted.

entries.title: Subscriptions is a rack
entries.line: Each source you follow is a cover on a shelf, grouped by kind: YouTube channels, podcasts, news and blogs, and more.

entries.title: Library Health tidies up when you say so
entries.line: Cleanup lists the items you haven't opened in months. Tick the ones you're done with and archive them in one go.

entries.title: Family Downtime
entries.line: Set screen-free times for the whole family, parents included.

entries.title: AI can approve requests
entries.line: When your child asks for something new, AI can approve it if it's educational and fits your guidelines. It is optional, and only for the situations you specify.

entries.title: Learning tracks
entries.line: Short lessons on a topic, from the topic to the first item.

entries.title: Save a page to a collection
entries.line: Keep what you find in collections, and share a collection with the people you choose.
